standard_prerequisites.name: Morphisms from graded ring maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the characterized triple (U(psi), r_psi, theta).

core_obligations: U(psi) = Y because D_+(f) = D_+(f^n) and fractions b/psi(f)^n can be taken with n arbitrarily large.
A_(f) to B_(psi(f)) is surjective by the same fraction argument, so r_psi is a closed immersion.
The same argument on A_f shows theta is surjective; the graded example A = k[x, y] with deg(x) = 1, deg(y) = 2 and I = (x) gives theta not an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Cover by standard opens, run the fraction representation argument, mirror it for the untwisted localizations, and exhibit the counterexample.
difficulty_reason: Fraction representation argument for surjectivity of the chart ring maps, theta surjectivity by the same mechanism, and a worked non-isomorphism example; fully displayed.
